The review is described as waived via a VP email with no ticket, which is not a recorded review.","evidence_quote":"Legal review: waived per VP email, no ticket.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Obtain and link the required pay/legal review ticket, or a formal documented waiver, before launch."}, {"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Switchback design leaks across arms for a lagged referral incentive","detail":"The bonus pays out after a recruit completes 50 deliveries, and recruited drivers stay in the pool after the market flips arms. Treatment effects therefore carry over between market-week periods and contaminate the control arm. A 4-week run also covers few switchback periods, and the 10-week target extends past the test.","evidence_quote":"Switchback by market-week. Duration: 4 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Use market-level geo randomization, or a switchback with washout periods. Run long enough to cover the referral-to-50-deliveries lag, and align the test duration with the 10-week target."}]}
